title: Reconstruction from a successful parse
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $l,l'$ be bit strings, and let $g$ be an arithmetic gate with $n$ possible input variables. If parsing $l$ with the gate parser for $n$ variables returns the gate $g$ and remainder $l'$, then $l$ is the encoding of $g$ followed by $l'$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is an arithmetic gate with $n$ possible input variables
